historical_phase17: permanently interrupted/failed; no checkpoint reuse or relabeling

source.new_controller: Separately versioned standalone Phase 17.1 controller; specified in PROPOSAL.md, not implemented or packaged by this proposal. Hash exact reviewed implementation and allowlisted transfer before any execution.

training.precision: CUDA native bfloat16 autocast; float32 weights, gradients and AdamW moments; no GradScaler

data.shuffle: CPU torch.randperm over all windows, seed 160; one permutation; no epoch wrap

initialization.candidate: only new attempt final planned update 7485

numerical_policy.unsupported_operation: error and stop; never warn-only or fallback policy changes

budgets.resource_estimate_note: Deterministic diagnostic 486.8240514 seconds / 997 updates projects ~3655 seconds for 7485 with per-update hashing, excluding full corpus preparation/validation/checkpoints; not measured full training duration.

bind: global RNG state or reproducible unchanged initial state
checkpoint_contract.restore: strict unchanged native loader plus mandatory Phase 17.1 sidecar verification; missing/mismatched sidecar is terminal
checkpoint_contract.replay: exact per-update model/optimizer/sampler/RNG/input fingerprints and exact same-Windows schedule for all previously logged overlap, plus unchanged absolute loss bound 1e-5; stop before extending beyond a failing overlap
checkpoint_contract.interruption_review: Mac must classify interruption and bound lost work/time before any same-attempt resume; at most two, no new run or settings

evaluation.reference: preserved Phase 5 base, never failed Phase 17
additional_requirements: ARC-Easy Wilson lower bound above chance
evaluation.development: paired fixed development after valid complete training only; failure terminal
evaluation.final: one paired final comparison only after development and resource gates pass and separate Mac selection/contamination review; exact candidate hash in declaration; no final feedback tuning
evaluation.phase18: blocked; no authorization implied even if all gates pass

pre_execution_requirements: Explicit owner authorization of this prespecified attempt, including bounded implementation/preflight and one fresh run.
Implement separate controller and sidecar bindings without changing native core, historical contracts or acceptance gates.
Complete separate code review and focused no-update CPU checks; freeze exact source commit and transfer hash before Windows execution.
On Windows verify existing pinned runtime, actual inputs and retained historical Phase 5 reference; fresh output root; no old model initialization.

Run only prespecified tiny CUDA adapter conformance checks (two 8+5-update pairs in each of checkout and isolated existing-wheel runtime; at most 52 updates total) and zero-update full-cache/source/readback checks. Never use these fixture weights.
If any source/runtime/data/control/budget/preflight identity fails, stop before serious optimization; no substitution or budget reset.
stop_conditions: Nonfinite loss, gradients, weights or optimizer state: retain failure and stop; no retry of numerical failure.
OOM, >85% reserved VRAM, >8 GiB host RSS, >20 GiB new artifacts, or wall budget reached: save only a valid completed boundary when possible, retain evidence and stop.
Identity, corruption, split, target or recovery mismatch: fail closed.
Unexpected external interruption: at most two restores of exact completed checkpoint and same configuration/runtime; log repeated/lost exposure separately; never count it as new unique data.
Fixed development or final acceptance failure: preserve negative result and block Phase 18; no tuning from final feedback.
Any numerical policy or full-state fingerprint mismatch is terminal; preserve the result and stop.
Any post-approval material recipe, budget, policy or acceptance change requires separate approval.

adapter_preflight.token_formula: For window i, length=2+(29*i)%511; interior token j at positions 1..length-2 is 4+((7*i+3*j)%252); first token 1, last token 2; synthetic IDs only.
adapter_preflight.comparison: exact full states and same-host schedule/inputs at restore and every replayed update, plus absolute loss delta <=1e-5
